open_points.subject: randomly minted entity identities
open_points.question: Which module or capability supplies randomness and collision-checked minting for `trial_execution_id`, `binding_id`, `run_id`, `approval_id` and `grant_id`?
options: Each record-owning module generates random identifiers and checks its own records for collisions
A shared lower-level capability generates and collision-checks all randomly minted identifiers
The store mints identifiers atomically while writing each record
open_points.default_guess: Have the store mint each identifier atomically with the record write, retrying on collision.

open_points.subject: agent-name uniqueness after configuration reload
open_points.text: “names are unique in an installation, and a configuration repeating one is refused at start” contradicts “Exactly three checks apply to a re-read: the file can be read and parsed; every token is at least 43 characters; no two tokens are equal.”
open_points.question: When a changed configuration repeats an `agent_name`, must the per-request re-read reject the new token list, or may it install two tokens that produce the same Actor identity?
options: Reject the re-read and refuse all requests until agent names are unique
Accept the re-read because agent-name uniqueness is checked only at process start
Accept it but distinguish agents by an additional identity not currently modeled
open_points.default_guess: Reject the re-read and refuse requests until the agent names are unique.
